name: 2 Kings
lede: The twelfth book of the Bible, in full: Elijah taken up in the whirlwind, Elisha's wonders, Jehu's furious driving, Hezekiah and Josiah, and Jerusalem burned by Babylon, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Chariot of Fire
books.blurb: Ahaziah fallen through the lattice inquires of Baal-zebub; a hairy man girt with a girdle of leather; fire from heaven on the captains of fifty; then Gilgal, Beth-el and Jericho — I will not leave thee; the Jordan divided by the mantle; a double portion of thy spirit; a chariot of fire and horses of fire, and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

books.name: The Pot of Oil
books.blurb: Three kings in the wilderness of Edom without water — bring me a minstrel; the valley full of trenches and the water red as blood; the widow's pot of oil and the borrowed vessels; the great woman of Shunem and the little chamber on the wall; my head, my head; it is well; the child sneezed seven times; death in the pot, and twenty loaves for a hundred men.

books.name: Naaman
books.blurb: Naaman the leper and the little maiden of Israel; go and wash in the Jordan seven times — are not Abanah and Pharpar better?; his flesh came again like the flesh of a little child; Gehazi's lie and the leprosy white as snow; the axe-head that swam; Dothan and the mountain full of horses and chariots of fire; and the siege of Samaria.

books.name: The Siege of Samaria
books.blurb: To-morrow a measure of fine flour for a shekel — if Jehovah should make windows in heaven; four leprous men at the gate and the camp of the Syrians empty in the twilight; this day is a day of good tidings; the Shunammite's land restored; Hazael and the forty camels' burden, and the man of God wept; and the kings Jehoram and Ahaziah of Judah.

books.name: Jehu
books.blurb: The vial of oil poured on Jehu's head in an inner chamber — I have anointed thee king over Israel; is it peace?; the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he driveth furiously; the portion of Naboth; Jezebel at the window; the seventy sons; and the house of Baal broken down.

books.name: Joash
books.blurb: Athaliah destroys the seed royal, and Jehosheba hides the child Joash six years in the house of Jehovah; Jehoiada's covenant with the captains; the crown and the testimony — long live the king; Athaliah's cry, Treason! treason!; then Jehoash and the breaches of the house, the chest with a hole in its lid, and the hallowed things sent to Hazael.

books.name: The Bones of Elisha
books.blurb: Elisha sick unto death — my father, my father, the chariots of Israel; the arrow of victory shot out of the window eastward, and the ground smitten thrice; the dead man who touched the bones of Elisha and revived; Amaziah and the parable of the thistle and the cedar of Lebanon; the wall of Jerusalem broken down; and Jeroboam the son of Joash.

books.name: Ahaz
books.blurb: Azariah the leper king in his separate house; Zechariah, Shallum, Menahem, Pekahiah and Pekah, king after king in Samaria; Pul and Tiglath-pileser of Assyria; then Ahaz — I am thy servant and thy son; the altar after the fashion of the altar at Damascus, and the sea set down from off the brazen oxen.

books.name: Carried Away into Assyria
books.blurb: Hoshea and the three years' siege of Samaria; Israel carried away into Assyria, to Halah and the Habor and the cities of the Medes, because they had sinned — the high places, the two calves, the host of heaven; strangers brought into the cities of Samaria, the lions, and every nation making gods of its own.

books.name: Hezekiah
books.blurb: Hezekiah who trusted in Jehovah breaks the brazen serpent; Sennacherib at Lachish; Rabshakeh at the conduit of the upper pool — what confidence is this wherein thou trustest?; the men on the wall answer him not a word; the letter spread before Jehovah; the virgin daughter of Zion hath laughed thee to scorn; and that night the camp of the Assyrians.

books.name: The Shadow on the Dial
books.blurb: Hezekiah sick unto death turns his face to the wall — I have seen thy tears, fifteen years added; the shadow gone back ten steps on the dial of Ahaz; the envoys of Babylon shown all his treasures — all shall be carried to Babylon; then Manasseh, the line of Samaria and the plummet of the house of Ahab, and Amon.

books.name: Josiah
books.blurb: Josiah of eight years and the repairing of the house; I have found the book of the law; the king rends his clothes; Huldah the prophetess — because thy heart was tender; the covenant read by the pillar; the house cleansed and the high places defiled; the altar at Beth-el; such a passover; and Megiddo.
